item.title: Ep 1: Architecture Patterns — Choosing Like a Staff Engineer
item.description:
Maya and Jordan walk through MVC, MVVM, MVI, and the Composable Architecture — not as a textbook tour, but through the Staff-level lens: which pattern earns its complexity for a given team, app, and trajectory, across iOS and Android.

Chapters

  • 00:00 — Cold open
  • 00:44 — Why patterns matter at Staff scope
  • 01:55 — MVC and why mobile outgrew it
  • 02:55 — MVVM, the workhorse
  • 04:18 — MVI and unidirectional data flow
  • 05:29 — TCA, the strict end of the spectrum
  • 06:57 — The Staff judgment call
  • 08:28 — Takeaway
